#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

long long modpow(long long a, long long n) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (n > 0) {
        if (n & 1) res = res * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        n >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

vector<vector<long long>> enumFIF(int n) {
    vector<long long> fact(n + 1), invfact(n + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    }
    long long a = fact[n];
    long long b = MOD;
    long long p = 1, q = 0;
    while (b > 0) {
        long long c = a / b;
        long long d = a;
        a = b;
        b = d % b;
        d = p;
        p = q;
        q = d - c * q;
    }
    invfact[n] = (p < 0 ? p + MOD : p);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        invfact[i] = invfact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % MOD;
    }
    return {fact, invfact};
}

long long C(int n, int r, const vector<vector<long long>>& fif) {
    if (n < 0 || r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    return fif[0][n] * fif[1][r] % MOD * fif[1][n - r] % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    int n, K, L;
    cin >> n >> K >> L;
    int mod = MOD;
    auto fif = enumFIF(10000);
    vector<long long> muls(n + 1, 0);
    for (int j = K; j <= n; j++) {
        long long c = C(n, j, fif);
        long long sign = ((j + K) & 1) == 0 ? 1 : -1;
        long long comb = C(j - 1, K - 1, fif);
        muls[j] = c * sign % mod * comb % mod;
        if (muls[j] < 0) muls[j] += mod;
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = K; i <= n; i++) {
        ans += modpow(2, i) * fif[0][i] % mod * fif[0][i] % mod
               * fif[1][2 * i + 1] % mod * muls[i];
        ans %= mod;
    }
    if (ans < 0) ans += mod;
    cout << ans * L % mod << endl;
    return 0;
}
